title: Trulite Glass & Aluminum Solutions
description:
Trulite Glass & Aluminum Solutions is one of the largest independent glass and aluminum fabricators in North America. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, the company operates 42 manufacturing and distribution facilities across the United States and Canada, employing approximately 1,700 people. Trulite is a portfolio company of Truelink Capital, a Los Angeles–based private equity firm that acquired the company from Sun Capital Partners in 2022.

Annual Revenue: $693,500,000 (FY2025 audited) Total Assets: $651,000,000 Total Debt: $355,700,000
